arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from funcy import rcurry, rpartial, get_spec

def add_kwonly(a, b, *, c=10):
    return a + b + c

# Get spec before and after currying
print(f"Original function:")
print(f"  get_spec(add_kwonly) = {get_spec(add_kwonly)}")

wrapped = rcurry(add_kwonly)
print(f"\nAfter rcurry:")
print(f"  type(wrapped) = {type(wrapped)}")
print(f"  get_spec(wrapped) = {get_spec(wrapped)}")

# Check what unwrap does
from funcy.decorators import unwrap
unwrapped = unwrap(wrapped)
print(f"  unwrap(wrapped) = {unwrapped}")
print(f"  get_spec(unwrap(wrapped)) = {get_spec(unwrapped)}")

# Test rpartial
p = rpartial(add_kwonly, 1)
print(f"\nAfter rpartial:")
print(f"  type(p) = {type(p)}")
print(f"  get_spec(p) = {get_spec(p)}")
EOF
